workflow.name: Employee Leave Alert System
workflow.description: Automatically manages employee leave notifications based on local mock data. Checks daily for leave activations and resets.

workflow_steps.name: fetch_leave_records
workflow_steps.description: Read all employee leave records from local mock storage (simulates Google Sheets).

workflow_steps.name: validate_normalize_leave_data
workflow_steps.description: Validate fields and compute needsActivation / needsReset flags against today's date.

workflow_steps.name: notify_hr_channel
workflow_steps.description: Post leave-activated message to HR Slack channel. Runs for each record where needsActivation=True.

workflow_steps.name: send_ooo_reminder_email
workflow_steps.description: Email the employee to update their Slack status to Out of Office.

workflow_steps.name: mark_leave_as_active
workflow_steps.description: Update leave record status to Active to prevent duplicate activations.

workflow_steps.name: notify_hr_leave_reset
workflow_steps.description: Post leave-completed message to HR Slack channel. Runs for each record where needsReset=True.

workflow_steps.name: send_welcome_back_email
workflow_steps.description: Email the employee a welcome back message.

workflow_steps.name: mark_leave_as_inactive
workflow_steps.description: Reset leave record status to Inactive.
